nodes.name: 插鳞石前
who: the small hooded girl who walked up alone
the scale-sparse keeper of the stone
nodes.light: the cold blue-grey of heavy snow at dusk, with a faint blue-green and amber glow coming from the fresh scales on the stone
nodes.camera: low and close to the girl's shoulder, looking past her at the stone and the man; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the top of a mountain pass in the first heavy snow of winter. A weathered standing stone taller than a man rises at the left of the picture, its whole face layered with thousands of overlapping dark scales pushed into the rock like fish-scale roof tiles; the lowest layers are bleached white, the top layers are fresh and faintly glow blue-green and amber. Beyond it a great ridge of rock curves away in rib-like arches into the falling snow, and far below, tiny, a camp of tents with a thread of smoke sits at the foot of the slope. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a thin eleven-year-old girl has just arrived and is shaking snow from a hood two sizes too big. We see her from the front at three-quarter: messy silver-white hair sticking out in every direction, a smudge of grey on her pointed cheek, an undyed greyish cloth coat soaked at the hem, scabs on the backs of her small hands, her pale-gold pupils, which were rounded in hiding, now stretched into upright slits, a few fine scales showing again along her wrists. She stands very straight and looks at the stone, scared and not showing it. A step behind her, at the stone, a tall thin man of about forty-nine, seen in profile, half of the dark blue-green scales gone from his face and neck, short blue-black hair, a long wool travelling coat with a soft flat collar and one row of plain round buttons, is bending to sweep snow off the lowest layer of scales with a straw broom. His amber vertical pupils are not on her face but on her worn boots. Snow falls heavy and large out of focus across the near corners, and a few flakes catch the glow of the stone.
nodes.note: 一幕里最有画面的是伊丝卡独自走到插鳞石前、卡尔戈先看她的脚（源稿第359到360行）。薇洛、猎鳞人营远处只给一句。

nodes.name: 暗青的路
who: the man who is walking into the gorge
the small girl who sits waiting at its mouth
nodes.light: flat grey early-spring light at the mouth of the gorge, with a dull blue-green glow rising from the ground under the man's boots against the dark stone walls
nodes.camera: low behind the girl's shoulder, looking past her into the gorge; the walls frame both sides; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: grey morning at the mouth of a narrow gorge in the mountains, a thin crust of old snow on the ground. Two walls of dark stone, shaped like upside-down scales, lean toward each other and narrow to a slit of fog at the back of the picture; snow falls from the sky only as far as the mouth and stops there. In the near right foreground, partly cut off by the frame, the small silver-white-haired girl in a hood two sizes too big sits on the ground hugging her knees, seen from behind at three-quarter so we see one pointed cheek, watching the man. A few steps in front of her, in the middle of the picture, a tall thin man in a long wool travelling coat is walking away from us into the gorge, seen from behind: short blue-black hair, the dark blue-green scales on his neck and the backs of his hands standing up one by one as if turned over from the inside. A straw broom leans against a boulder at the gorge mouth behind him. Under each of his steps a patch of dull blue-green light has lit on the ground in the shape of a single scale, and the patches run away ahead of him into the fog like a path. On a low slope far at the right, small, about thirty hunters sit in rows in the snow with bows and curved knives, their dogs with tails tucked; in front of them one tall woman with a long wine-red braid and a dark leather coat sits with her hands on her knees and does not stand. Thin mist parts in two along the path. A few last snowflakes drift large and out of focus in the near corners.
nodes.note: 挑幕终那一瞬：谷口的雾分开，脚下亮起暗青的路（源稿第372行），伊丝卡坐在谷口、猎鳞人坐在坡上（第367、369行）。

nodes.name: 两点浅金
who: the small girl who waits by the crack
the hunter woman on the slope
nodes.light: night with no lamps: the only warm light is the pair of pale-gold points of the girl's eyes, against deep blue-black snow and fog
nodes.camera: over the hunter woman's shoulder from the slope, looking down at the small girl; the woman's knee and knife fill the near foreground; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the third night at the mouth of a narrow gorge, thick fog sealing the crack between two dark stone walls at the far end of the picture, snow falling lightly. In the middle distance the small eleven-year-old girl sits on the ground facing the fog, her back to us, a hood two sizes too big pushed back; she has turned her head a little so that we see her cheek in profile, and her upright slit pupils glow as two small pale-gold points in the dark. She has half a black-rye cake in her hands and a strip of straw rope lying beside her worn boot, tied once around the sole. We look at her from the slope above, over the shoulder of a tall woman with a long wine-red braid and a dark leather coat, who fills the near right foreground, partly cut off by the frame, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one ice-blue eye: she sits with a curved skinning knife resting across her knees, and a brass one-litre measuring cup lies turned upside down on her knee. Her face is unreadable and tired, her eyes on the child. Behind and beside her the hunters' camp lies asleep, a row of low tents and a few dogs curled in the snow, one man awake and pointing at the girl's glowing eyes. Fine snowflakes drift large and out of focus across the near corners, a few of them lit pale gold.
nodes.note: 三幕里挑第三夜：伊丝卡的竖瞳亮成两点浅金，薇洛把量杯扣在膝盖上（源稿第376行），鞋底草绳是第二天的事，并进同一幅（第377行）。

nodes.name: 谷口落鳞
who: the man who walked out of the gorge
the girl who picks up the scale
nodes.light: pale gold first light from the right, spreading across clean snow, with cool blue shadow in the gorge behind
nodes.camera: low in the snow at the gorge mouth, looking up at the man with the girl crouched at his feet; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn at the mouth of a narrow gorge after three nights of fog; the fog is closing again behind us in the gorge and the snow in front is clean and gold. In the middle of the picture a tall thin man of about forty-nine stands just outside the gorge mouth, seen from the front at three-quarter: he has half of his dark blue-green scales gone from his face, neck and hands, the rest sparse and dull, short blue-black hair, a long wool travelling coat with a soft flat collar; under his throat is a pale scar where a reverse-growing scale used to be, and his amber vertical pupils are lowered to look at the ground at his feet. His hands are empty, he holds nothing. At his feet in the near left foreground, partly cut off by the frame, the small silver-white-haired girl in her oversized hood crouches in the snow and lifts out of it a single dark blue-green scale bigger than her own palm, its edge catching the light; she holds it in both hands as if it were warm. On a snow slope far behind, small, a line of hunters is already breaking camp, tents folded, a tall woman with a long wine-red braid standing apart with her back to us, her collar open by one button. Beyond the gorge mouth a crowd of grey-robed dragonkin elders waits at the foot of a standing stone covered with layered scales. Powdery snow lifts large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束头一条：喉下那片倒着长的鳞落在谷口，伊丝卡捡了回去（源稿第384行）。

nodes.name: 两处剑影
who: the sword-bearer on the gravel bar
nodes.light: low warm gold evening sun from the left across river water, with long blue shadows on the gravel bars
nodes.camera: low at the water's edge, looking along the shallows toward the wagons; the sword-bearer in the near foreground cut off by the frame; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late afternoon in autumn, a wide shallow river in a valley of yellowing trees. A train of twenty-one covered wagons is crossing the upstream shallows one at a time, the water up to the horses' bellies; guards stand in the water to the knee holding the wheel rims. On the lead wagon sits a small round-faced halfling woman of about fifty with a bundle of tally strips in her hand, her head turned to look back; her two grown sons walk beside the first and the last wagon. The wagons carry barrels and sacks, not a single one is wet. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a very broad-shouldered man of about forty stands on a gravel bar with his back three-quarter to us: short grey-brown hair that looks cut with his own blade, a square face with one old scar across the bridge of the nose, deep slate-grey eyes on the water, a plain two-handed greatsword with no pattern on his back in a scabbard wrapped in old leather, a faded grey-brown coat. He stands very still and his hands are empty. Far away at the left, small, at the old ford downstream, an identical tall figure with a sword on its back stands in the glare of the water, and the river runs round the feet of both. Gold leaves and drifting river mist hang large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕里挑末一辆车过水那一瞬：上游滩头和来时的渡口各站着一个背剑的影子（源稿第433行）。海泽尔、车队二十一辆照开局。

nodes.name: 断口
nodes.light: hard pale daylight from the upper left with long cold shadows, against the dull gold of the autumn grass
nodes.camera: low in the grass at the foot of the summit, looking up at the man against the sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a bare grassy hill in late autumn under a pale grey sky. At the summit stands a dead tree with a faded grey banner tied to one branch. Directly under it, in the middle of the picture, the very broad-shouldered man of about forty has just reached the top alone, seen from below at three-quarter, his plain two-handed greatsword drawn and held out to one side at shoulder height, his slate-grey eyes calm, his mouth shut. Around him in the tall grass about thirty men and women have risen from hiding, bows and short spears and curved hunting blades in their hands, and the blades are breaking: a dozen curved blades have snapped in two and their white clean-edged pieces spin in the air around him, catching the light. The raiders nearest him stare at their empty hands. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, the older leader of the band, with two fingers missing from his left hand, clutches his own right arm that hangs wrong at the elbow, his face grey, blood on his sleeve. Down the slope far below, small, a ring of twenty-one wagons is drawn up with the oxen unhitched inside it, and a tiny halfling woman stands on a wagon roof. Dry grass seeds and broken blade fragments streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕挑他一个人上了坡、刀断了一片的那一瞬（源稿第440到443行）。劫道头子右胳膊断了，是成年人，所以 raw 为真；坡上没有死人。

nodes.name: 垂刃
nodes.light: deep gold-red from the central hearth, against the cold blue-black of night in the doorway
nodes.camera: low at the floor behind the hearth, looking across the fire toward the door; the fire fills the lower foreground; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a low, long stone hall with a single great hearth fire burning gold-red in the middle, eight beds around it, an iron-bound door at the far end. In the middle of the picture the young priestess of twenty-four stands in front of the fire with a log in one hand, facing the door: curly orange-red hair tied up carelessly with a strip of cloth, stray curls over her forehead, honey-coloured eyes, a round face with a scatter of freckles, a hemp robe, a ring of keys at her belt, old burn marks over both hands. She has just thrown on another log and the flames have jumped up gold. In the doorway stand about eight raiders, half of them bandaged, who came in with their blades drawn halfway; as the firelight touches the steel the blade tips sag toward the floor as if falling asleep, and the men's wrists hang heavy. At the door, partly cut off at the right edge, a very broad-shouldered man of forty with short grey-brown hair has just stepped in with his hands empty; his greatsword already stands in a big wooden barrel by the door among the other knives and hilts. In the near left foreground the leader of the raiders, a fifty-year-old with two fingers missing from his left hand, lies on a bed with a freshly splinted right arm, feverish, his eyes on the sword-bearer. Sparks and warm smoke drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕挑拔出一半的刀照着火光垂下去（源稿第452行）。桶、门口的人照第451行。

nodes.name: 桶里的刀
nodes.light: the cool grey-gold of early morning coming through the open door, warmed by the hearth glow behind us
nodes.camera: from inside the hall at the door frame, looking out across the barrel toward the morning; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early morning at the door of a low stone hall, the yard outside bright with frost and three old oak trees whose leaves have turned yellow. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, the young priestess of twenty-four leans in the open doorway with her shoulder against the frame and her arms crossed, seen from the side at three-quarter: curly orange-red hair tied up with a strip of cloth, freckles, honey-coloured eyes, a hemp robe, keys at her belt, her scarred hands tucked under her arms; she is watching, tired and quietly pleased. In the middle of the picture beside her stands a big wooden barrel full of knives and short blades with their hilts up. The fifty-year-old leader of the raiders, two fingers missing from his left hand, his right arm bound across his chest in a belt sling, is reaching into the barrel with his left hand and taking out his own knife; behind him about seven other men and women wait their turn in a line across the yard, heavy-eyed, a few of them bandaged. Beyond them, far at the end of the picture, a faint line of little figures and a wagon is leaving along a road between fields. Inside, behind us, the hearth fire glows low and a broad-shouldered man with a plain greatsword sits by it with his back to the door. Frost glitter and a few falling yellow leaves drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束挑头子把刀一把一把从桶里拿回去（源稿第459行）。幕终那一夜火边坐着的人画成背影。

nodes.name: 完整的雷
who: the young thunder hunter with the small pelt
nodes.light: violet light from the thirty-one hides glowing on the gate above, against the last warm copper dusk in the sky
nodes.camera: low among the crowd at his side, looking up at the young man and the gate behind him; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the gate of a valley city whose walls and hills are the colour of copper. Above the dark arched gate thirty-one wolf hides hang in rows, and each has a faint violet line of light running slowly across it, so that the gate looks like a bank of small thunderclouds. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a lean young man of twenty-two stands with his arms spread, shaking out a small pelt: he is seen from the front at three-quarter, about 181 cm, black hair with one forelock burned white, pale thunder-violet eyes, a smile that sits higher at one corner, a branching scar like an upside-down tree running from his left shoulder up the side of his neck, a grey-brown hide cloak, a bone knife at his belt, soft-soled boots with no nails, no iron anywhere on him. On the small pelt a single unbroken line of violet light runs from edge to edge. Around him a crowd has gathered: tanners with brown-stained hands, miners with copper dust on their shoulders, two foreign merchants in travel cloaks. At the left edge of the crowd one very old hunter in a worn hide cloak has already turned his back and is walking away without a word. Far behind, a tall tower stands on a rock shelf above the gate. Violet sparks and copper dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕挑他把小皮抖开、围着一圈人的那一瞬（源稿第508行），老猎雷人图利奥转身走了；皮上一道完整的雷。

nodes.name: 白树
nodes.light: cold bone-white from the trees themselves and a faint flicker on the far horizon, against deep violet-black night
nodes.camera: low among the roots, looking up past the young man at the white trees; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a stony wasteland outside a valley, no wind, no sound. A grove of dead-straight trees stands across the picture, every trunk and branch bone-white as if buried in frost, their bark split in long forked cracks. The ground under the nearest tree is marked by rings of scorched black earth in the shape of curled animals, where something large has lain. In the middle of the picture the lean young man of twenty-two, black hair with one white forelock, stands alone beneath the nearest white tree, seen from behind at three-quarter so we see one cheek and one pale violet eye: he wears a grey-brown hide cloak, soft boots, a bone knife, and carries no iron. He has stopped and is looking up into the white branches, one hand clamped on his left shoulder where an old branching scar runs up his neck. His face is still and shut. Far away on the horizon between the trunks the sky flickers pale white again and again with no sound, over a dark valley whose tiny city gate shows a row of violet points. Small white flakes of ash drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕挑他夜里进荒地、在白树底下站了很久（源稿第519行）。九雷不入画，只有烧焦的印子。

nodes.name: 还皮
who: the young thunder hunter carrying the pelt
nodes.light: the white flash of a silent bolt from the left, against violet-black night and the violet glow of the hides on the gate
nodes.camera: behind and a little above the man, looking down the gate steps toward the beast on the plain; wide-angle and strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the ninth night of a valley city's fall, the plain outside its gate lit white by lightning that makes no sound. We stand on the stone steps of the gate looking out. In the near middle of the picture a lean young man in a grey-brown hide cloak walks down the steps away from us, seen from behind at three-quarter, black hair with one white forelock, no hide cloak of the ordinary kind but only a plain shirt, soft boots without nails, no iron; he holds a small wolf pelt against his chest in both arms, carefully, the way one carries a child, and a single unbroken violet line runs across it. Above and behind him, on the gate, thirty-one hides all burn violet at once, the middle one dark where it has been taken down. Ahead of him on the plain a huge storm-maned wolf lies like a low mountain, grey with a crackling mane, electric veins running across half the sky behind it; around it dozens of smaller wolves stand in rings and every one of them has arcs of light moving over its coat. The tall beast's head is raised and turned toward the man. Far to the right a tiny line of people with lanterns goes into a mine mouth in the hillside. Violet sparks and white ash drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕挑第九夜他抱着小皮往狼群那边走（源稿第530行）。九雷参考图用 moon_021_1。人是背影，不画他被雷劈到。

nodes.name: 矿口天亮
who: the tanner woman at the mine mouth
nodes.light: clear gold sunrise from the front, against the cold white flicker of silent lightning on the mountains behind
nodes.camera: from outside on the slope, low, looking back at the mine mouth as children step out; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise at the far side of a mountain, a rough tunnel mouth cut into a copper-coloured hillside. About a dozen children and old people are coming out of the dark one after another into bright daylight, each letting go of the hem of the one in front as they step onto the sunlit stones, squinting. In the middle of the picture, last in the line, at the very mouth of the tunnel, stands a sturdy young woman of twenty-four, seen from the front at three-quarter: long peach-pink hair coiled up under an indigo headscarf spotted with dye, one small beauty mark between her brows, olive-green eyes, a round face, lips pressed together, a tanner's apron, all ten fingers stained brown, the last mine lamp swinging from her hand. She has turned her head to look back over her shoulder into the tunnel, not at the light. Behind and above her, over the peaks, the sky is still covered in a slow white flicker with no sound, and far down the valley behind her a row of black gate arches stands empty with no hides on them. In the near right foreground, partly cut off by the frame, a small child holds a worn bag of coins to its chest with both hands. Warm dust and sparks of sunlight drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束挑菲妮最后一个出矿口、孩子松开衣角站到日头底下（源稿第535行）。那袋钱是贾罗卖马的钱，塞给了一个孩子。

nodes.name: 炉口之盾
nodes.light: furnace orange pouring out of the forge mouth against the cold blue-grey of dawn in the cliff opening behind
nodes.camera: low from beside the anvil, looking across at the smith with the glowing shield between us and the furnace; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn inside a dwarven forge cut into a cliff face, a row of furnace mouths along the rock and a rack of round iron shields of every size on the wall behind. In the middle of the picture a short broad dwarf of about 136 cm, with a red-brown beard braided in two plaits and iron-grey eyes, holds a huge iron shield wider than himself up to the furnace mouth and looks at the heat in it; he is seen from the side at three-quarter. The fire has hit the shield face and a ring of runes burns bright along its rim and the flames curl away around its edge, leaving his leather apron and tunic behind it untouched. His boots are worn through at the soles and the left one is stitched with copper wire. On the far side of the anvil, small, a very young-looking dwarf of seventy with a thin golden-brown beard tied in one small knob, light blue eyes squeezed shut, hands wrapped in cloth, pulls the bellows with his whole body; on his back is a small round shield that has not sold. A deep notch is cut into the shield rim, the number one hundred and twelve, in a row of marks. Far beyond the cliff opening behind them, small, a narrow stone bridge over a white torrent. Sparks and forge ash drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕挑哈尔加把一百一十二号盾迎着炉口、火沿盾边卷开（源稿第583行），博里拉风箱。盾上的数不画成字，写成刻痕。

nodes.name: 平石
nodes.light: hard white-gold afternoon light from the right, with a yellow-ochre glow rising from the stone under the smith's boots
nodes.camera: low on the bridge beside the smith, looking along the bridge at the charging horsemen; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: afternoon on a narrow stone bridge over a roaring white torrent at the foot of a cliff. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a short broad dwarf of about 136 cm with a red-brown beard braided in two plaits stands at the bridge head with an enormous iron shield upright in front of him, seen from the side at three-quarter, his heel planted on a flat stone; under his boot a yellow-ochre light has lit and spreads across the stone in root-like lines. His iron-grey eyes are fixed ahead, his mouth shut. He is hurt: arrows stand in the shield face and a few in his shoulder and side, not deep, and blood runs from a graze on his temple and down into his beard; his leather apron is torn. Down the bridge, at full charge, a line of horsemen on horses in copper-plated barding, a knight at their head with a shield painted with a bird holding an ore stone, breaks against the shield like surf on a rock, men and horses thrown back and white spray rising. A drift of arrow shafts floats down the river below. In the middle of the river, small, on a rock, sits a barefoot man in clothes the colour of river water, looking at the bridge; the current parts around his feet. Splinters, spray and arrow feathers fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕挑冲桥撞在盾上、脚下平石亮黄岩光的那一瞬（源稿第592到593行）。河当中那一位照源稿用凡人样子画，不点破。

nodes.name: 箭眼
who: the apprentice who has run back
nodes.light: yellow-ochre light streaming through the arrow holes of the shield, against the deep blue of dusk and a faint orange sky in the west
nodes.camera: behind the young dwarf's shoulder, looking at the smith's front, the shield filling the middle of the picture; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk on a narrow stone bridge over a white torrent, a cliff rising at the left. In the middle of the picture the short broad dwarf smith of about 136 cm stands propped upright behind his huge iron shield, the shield bottom set in a crack in the stone, seen from the front: red-brown beard in two plaits, iron-grey eyes closed, his head sunk, arrow shafts standing in his shoulder and side, his hammer lying on the bridge at his feet. The shield is pierced all over with arrow holes so dense that the yellow-ochre light coming up from the stone under it shines through every hole in thin bright rays, and his shadow is thrown across the cliff wall in a huge pattern of points. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a young-looking dwarf of seventy, round and stout, with a thin golden-brown beard in a small knob and a face smudged with ash, has just run up and put both hands on the smith's arm, his mouth open to say the one word 'Master'. Behind him, down the bridge, a file of grey-bearded dwarves with hammers and round shields is arriving at the run out of the dusk. In the far background, small, a rock in the middle of the river is empty, only a ring of rippling water. Dust and fading light dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕挑博里领援军赶到、扶住他、箭眼里透出光的那一瞬（源稿第602到603行）。博里七十岁，看着十七岁，他自己没有伤。

nodes.name: 两个脚印
who: the smith who walks around the prints
nodes.light: clean soft morning light from the left, warm on the stone, with a pale blue sky over the cliff
nodes.camera: low and close to the flat stone, looking along the bridge; the footprints in the near foreground; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: bright morning on a narrow stone bridge at the foot of a cliff. In the near foreground, sharp, set into the flat stone at the bridge head, are two boot prints, each about an inch deep, with the marks of boot nails pressed hard into the rock inside them. A small child of about five has knelt on the stone and laid one small hand flat inside one of the prints, measuring; a second child squats beside it with a hand spread across the other. A few villagers in plain wool and leather, farmers and charcoal burners from the seven villages, stand at the right in a quiet half-circle looking down, a woman with a sack of grain at her feet, saying nothing. At the middle left, beyond the prints, a short broad dwarf of about 136 cm with a red-brown beard in two plaits and iron-grey eyes walks past in worn boots, the left one patched with copper wire; he has stopped and looks at the stone, walking round the prints and not stepping into them, one hand on the bridge rail. Behind him, small, a dwarf apprentice with a round shield on his back and golden-brown beard threads a piece of copper wire for him. Down the river a few arrow shafts still float in the white water. Straw dust and sun-lit grains drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束挑桥头平石上的两个脚印、七个村子的人来看、孩子用手去比（源稿第610、612行）。哈尔加绕过去不踩进去是往后的事，这里先画他停下看。

贾罗.when: 月银纪4300年炎潮月，第九夜
贾罗.how: 第九夜他把城门正当中那一张小皮取下来，抱在怀里，往狼群那边走，那一夜的雷还是落了下来，谷底城塌了。他死在城门外，怀里抱着那一张小皮。

铜谷的王.when: 月银纪4300年炎潮月，第九夜
铜谷的王.how: 第九夜它到了谷底城，城门上的雷皮一齐亮起来，王在城堡里没有出来。谷底城塌了，他死在城堡里。

deaths.name: 怀里的皮
deaths.light: a huge silent white flash from the right that blanches everything, against violet-black night
deaths.camera: low on the plain in front of the wolves, looking back up at the man and the gate; strongly tilted
deaths.text: Scene: the ninth night of a valley city's fall, a flat dark plain outside its gate. Behind us a huge storm-maned wolf lies like a low mountain with a crackling mane, electric veins running across half the sky, and dozens of smaller wolves stand in rings in the near foreground with arcs of light over their coats. In the middle of the picture, small before the beast, a lean young man of twenty-three stands in the open ground below the stone steps of the gate, seen from the front at three-quarter: black hair with one white forelock, pale thunder-violet eyes, a smile that sits higher at one corner and is gone now, a hide cloak and plain shirt, soft boots with no nails, no iron. He is holding a small wolf pelt against his chest in both arms, and a single unbroken violet line runs across it. He has just been caught by the white silent bolt: it lights him from the right and throws his shadow long to the left, his shirt and cloak are scorched and smoking at the shoulder, the skin of his left shoulder and neck marked with a fresh branching burn, his blood dark on his lip, and still he stands upright and does not step back. On the gate behind him thirty hides burn violet and the middle place above the arch is empty. Violet sparks and white ash fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
deaths.note: 源稿第530行：第九夜他抱着小皮往狼群那边走，死在城门外怀里抱着小皮。画雷刚落到他身上、他还站着的一瞬，不画倒下。年纪按4299年炎潮月二十二岁、4300年炎潮月二十三岁。

notes: 旅伴死期范围：按这一段3800到4350年算，薇洛、伊丝卡、茜贝尔、贾罗四人都死在里头，各出一幅；菲妮约4360年死，过了4350，没写；博里约4560年死，没写。
伊丝卡死在约122岁、薇洛约89岁、茜贝尔约84岁，都是老死，画的是最后做的那一件事，请主会话看要不要保留这三幅。
卡尔戈、哈尔加到了传奇、活到下一段，没有死期。
劳伦茨的fates标成下落不明；他是相遇，不是旅伴，没有死的那一刻。
铜谷的王、塞尔温·白石没有立绘，只写了死期；老猎雷人图利奥活着，没写。
d_jaro 与 c3 都用九雷参考图（c3 用 moon_021_1，d_jaro 用 moon_021_2），d_jaro 里九雷在观看者身后，画面只露狼群，请出图时当心别把它画到贾罗前面。
c3 里的 who 衣服选 casual，text 里写了不披雷皮，只穿衬衫，是照源稿第530行“身上没有披雷皮”。
d3、d2 里河当中那一位照凡人样子画，没写神光；源稿第594行明写他是渡石为桥者，由主会话定要不要保持不点破。

薇洛.how: 她回了人类的城，不再猎鳞。3860年她一个人回到山口，在插鳞石前站了一天，没有插。她死在城里，背上那三片鳞，她最后那些年没再刮。

伊丝卡.how: 她十六岁那年自己走进逆鳞谷，三天以后走了出来，天脊认了她。往后她接了卡尔戈守插鳞石的活，死在天脊，那一片倒着长的鳞挂在了插鳞石上，最底下那一层。

劳伦茨.label: 下落不明
劳伦茨.how: 他把剑留在三橡院的火边，空着手往南去了，谁也不知道他去了哪里。往后说路上有人的人，多半不知道那本来是一个人。

茜贝尔.how: 她守三橡院守到老，送火种的歌唱了一辈子，一回也没唱准，火照样暖。4149年那柄剑是她送进当铺的。她死在三橡院。

塞尔温·白石.label: 老死
塞尔温·白石.how: 他在城门边刻了一块又一块判例碑，判错的也刻上去。他老死在城里，城门边的碑立到第一百一十二块。

later_deaths.name: 背上三片
who: the old woman who was once a scale-hunter
later_deaths.light: soft late afternoon gold from the open shutter on the left, with warm brown shadow in the room
later_deaths.camera: from behind and a little to the side in the small room, looking past her shoulder at the window; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: late afternoon in a narrow upper room of a plain stone town house. A wooden shutter stands open on the left, with no glass, and a view of a grey-roofed town and, very far away, a faint ridge of high snow-topped mountains. In the middle of the picture an old woman of eighty-nine stands at the window seen from behind at three-quarter, so that we see one cheek: a long face with a sharp brow ridge, thin lips, pale ice-blue eyes turned toward the far mountains, her thick long braid now white with a few threads of wine-red left in it, hanging down her back over a plain linen shirt whose collar she has left open. On the bare skin of her upper back, between the shoulder blades, three pale scales, each as big as a thumbnail, show in a small row, not hidden and not scraped; she carries herself straight and still, one hand resting on the window sill. On a shelf behind her a brass one-litre measuring cup stands turned upside down, gathering dust, with her school's mark cut round its rim; no knife is in sight. The room holds a narrow bed, a stool and a jug of water, nothing else. Slow dust motes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
later_deaths.note: 源稿只给约3910年死在城里、背上那三片鳞最后那些年没再刮（源稿第783行）。画她最后站着的一瞬，房间是我补的。老妇人长相立绘参考是她年轻时，text 里写明白发。

later_deaths.name: 底层之鳞
who: the old keeper of the pass-stone
later_deaths.light: the cold blue of dusk snow, with a pale-gold glow from her eyes and a blue-green glow from the stone's fresh scales
later_deaths.camera: low and close beside the stone, looking up at her face and the hand that reaches the lowest layer; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: dusk at a mountain pass in a gentle snowfall. A weathered standing stone covered in thousands of layered dark scales rises at the left; its lowest layer is bleached white. In the middle of the picture an old half-dragon woman of a hundred and twenty-two kneels in the snow at its foot, seen from the front at three-quarter: long silver-white hair loose to her waist, a thin lined face with a pointed chin, pale-gold upright pupils that glow faintly, a few small gold scales left at her temples and wrists, a heavy grey wool cloak worn thin at the hem. She is hanging on the stone, on a peg driven into the lowest layer, a single dark blue-green scale bigger than a hand on a strand of old hemp cord, and her hand is just letting go of the cord. Her face is calm and settled, her mouth closed. At the foot of the stone leans a straw broom, its bristles worn short. Far below in the snowy slope, small, a single path leads down to a gorge between two dark rock walls with a drifting skirt of mist. Fine snow drifts large and out of focus across the near corners.
later_deaths.note: 源稿只给约3960年死在天脊、那一片倒着长的鳞挂在插鳞石上最底下一层（源稿第727行）。画她挂鳞那一下。散裔，活一百二十多岁，不是未成年。

later_deaths.name: 跑调的歌
later_deaths.light: deep gold-red from the central hearth, against the blue-black dark of the hall
later_deaths.camera: low at the hearth, looking up at her face from beside the fire; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: night in a long low stone hall with a single great hearth fire burning gold-red in the middle, eight beds around it, a plain wooden barrel by the door holding knives with their hilts up. In the middle of the picture an old woman of eighty-four stands in front of the fire with a log in her hands, seen from the front at three-quarter: curly hair gone white and still tied up in a strip of cloth with stray curls over her forehead, honey-coloured eyes, a round face whose freckles have faded among the lines, a hemp robe, a ring of keys at her belt, her hands covered in old burn marks. She is singing, her mouth slightly open and her head a little tilted to the wrong side of the tune, a small contented smile in her eyes; the flames have just caught the new log and leap up gold, lighting her face. On the nearest bed a sleeping traveller lies under a blanket with a boot hanging over the end. At the door at the far end, small, an empty sword hook is fixed on the wall beside the barrel, empty. Sparks and warm smoke drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
later_deaths.note: 源稿只给约4170年死在三橡院、送火种的歌唱了一辈子（源稿第466、905行）。画她最后添柴唱歌的一瞬。
